m: 1. पू cl. 9. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxxi, 12) पुनाति, पुनीते (3. pl. Ā. पुनते, AV., पुनते, RV.; 2. sg. Impv. P. पुनीहि, RV. &c., पुनाहि, SV.); cl. 1. Ā. (xxii, 70) पवते (of P. only Impv. -पव, RV. ix, 19, 3, and p. gen. pl. पवताम्, Bhag. x, 31; p. Ā. पुनान below, पवमान See p. 610, col. 3; 1. sg. Ā. पुनीषे, RV. vii, 85, 1; pf. पुपुवुः, ˚वे, Br.; अपुपोत्, RV. iii, 26, 8; aor. अपाविषुः Subj. अपविष्ट, RV.; fut. पविष्यति, पविता Gr.; ind.p. पूत्वा, AV.; पूत्वी, RV.; पवित्वा Gr.; -पूय and -पावम्, Br. &c.; inf. पवितुम्, Br.), to make clean or clear or pure or bright, cleanse, purify, purge, clarify, illustrate, illume (with सक्तुम्, ‘to cleanse from chaff, winnow’; with क्रतुम् or मनीषाम्, ‘to enlighten the understanding’; with हिरण्यम्, ‘to wash gold’), RV. &c. &c.; (met.) to sift, discriminate, discern; to think of or out, invent, compose (as a hymn), RV.; AV.; (Ā. पवते) to purify one's self, be or become clear or bright; (esp.) to flow off clearly (said of the Soma), RV.; to expiate, atone for, ib. vii, 28, 4; to pass so as to purify; to purify in passing or pervading, ventilate, RV. &c. (cf. √ पव्) : Pass. पूयते, to be cleaned or washed or purified; to be freed or delivered from (abl.), Mn.; MBh. &c.: Caus. पवयति or पावयति (ep. also ˚ते; aor. अपीपवत् Gr.; Pass. पाव्यते, Kāv.), to cleanse, purify, TS.; Br.; &c. : Desid., पुपूषति, पिपविषते Gr.: Desid. of Caus. पिपावयिषति Gr.

a: पूर्ण — p. p. [पुर्-क्त नि˚] 1 Filled, filled with, full of; opt. in comp; तं तथा कृपयाविष्टं अश्रुपूर्णाकुलेक्षणं Bg. 2. 1; so शोक˚, जल˚ &c. --2 Whole, full, entire, complete; R. 3. 38. --3 Fulfilled, accomplished. --4 Ended, completed. --5 Past, elapsed. --6 Satisfied, contented. --7 Full-sounding, sonorous. --8 Strong, powerful. --9 Selfish, or self-indulgent. --10 Drawn, bent (as a bow). --र्णा 1 An epithet of the fifteenth digit of the moon. --2 N. of the fifth, tenth, and fifteenth lunar days or tithis. --र्णं Ved. 1 Abundance, plenty. --2 Water. --Comp. --अंकः an integer. --अभिलाष a. satisfied, contented. --अमृता epithet of the sixteenth digit of the moon. --अवतारः N. of the fourth, seventh and eighth incarnations of Viṣṇu. --आनकं {1} a drum. {2} the sound of a drum. {3} a vessel. {4} a moon-beam. {5} = पूर्णपात्र q. v.; (sometimes read पूर्णालक also). --आनंदः the Supreme being. --आहूतिः f. an offering made with a full ladle. --इंदुः the full moon. --उपमा a full or complete simile, i. e. one in which the four requisites उपमान, उपमेय, साधारणधर्म and उपमाप्रतिपादक are all expressed; (opp. लुप्तोपमा); e. g. अंभोरुहमिवाताम्रं मुग्धे करतलं तव; see K. P. 10 under उपमा. --ककुद a. full-humped. --काम a. one whose desires are fulfilled, satisfied, contented. --(मः) N. of the Supreme being. --कुंभः {1} a full jar. {2} a vessel full of water. {3} a particular mode of fighting. {4} a hole (in a wall) of the shape of a water-jar; तदत्र पक्वेष्टके पूर्णकुंभ एव शोभते Mk. 3. --पर्वेंदु f. the day of full moon. --पात्रं {1} a full cup or jar. {2} a cup-ful. {3} a measure of capacity (equal to 256 handfuls). {4} a vessel (or a box or basket) filled with valuable things (such as clothes, ornaments &c.) and scrambled for by servants or relatives on festive occasions or distributed as presents; hence, the word is often used to denote ‘a present made to one who brings a happy news’; कदा मे तनयजन्ममहोत्सवानंदनिर्मरो हरिष्यति पूर्णपात्रं परिजनः K. 62, 70, 73, 165; सखीजनेनापह्रियमाणपूर्णपात्रां 299; तत्कामं प्रभवति पूर्णपात्रवृत्त्या स्वीकर्तुं मम हृदयं च जीवितं च Māl. 4. 1; (पूर्णपात्र is thus defined; --हर्षादुत्सवकाले यदलंकारांशुकादिकं . आकृष्य गृह्यते पूर्णपात्रं स्यात्पूर्णकं च तत् . or वर्धापकं यदानंदादलंकारादिकं पुनः .. आकृष्य गृह्यते पूर्णपात्रं पूर्णानकं च तत् .. Hārāvalī). {5} a vessel full of rice presented to the priests at the end of the sacrifice. --बी (वी) जः the citron. --मास् m. {1} the sun. {2} the moon. (f.) the day of full moon --मासः {1} the moon. {2} a monthly sacrifice performed on the day of full moon. --मासी the day of full moon. --होमः = पूर्णाहुतिः q. v.

prAmARyAnupapatteH taTA hi pratyakzaM tAvadidamasmAdBinnamiti nIlapItAderBedamaDyati । aTA manyeTAH kiM pratyakzaM BedamevAvagAhate kiM sA DarmipratiyogiGawitam । na praTamaH DarmipratiyogipratipattimantareRa tatsApekzasya BedasyASakyADyavasAyatvAt । dvitIyo'pi DarmipratiyogimahaRapurAsaraM BedagrahaRamaTa vA yugapat tatsarvagrahaRam । na pUrvaH budDerviramya vyApArABAvAt anyonyASrayaprasaNgAcca । nApi caramaH kAryyAkAraRabudDyA yOgapadyABAvAt DarmipratItihi Bedapratyayasya kAraRaM sannihite'pi DarmiRi vyavahitapratiyogijYAnamantareRa medasyAjYAtatvenAnDayavyatirekAByAM kAryyakAraRamAvAvagagAt । tasmAnna BedapratyakzaM suprasaramiti cet kiM vastusvarUpaBedavAdinaM prati imAni dUzaRAnyudGuzyante kiM vA DarmiBedavAdinaM prati । praTame corAparADAnmARqavyanigrahanyAyApAtaH BavadaBiDIyamAnadUzaRAnAM tadavizayatvAt । nanu vastusvarUpasyEva Bedatve pratiyogisApekzatvaM na Gawate GawAditattatpratiyogisApekza eva sarvatra BedaH prayata iti cenna praTamaM sarvato vilakzaRatayA vastusvarUpe jYAyamAne pratiyogyapekzayA viSizwavyavahAropapatteH taTA hi parimARaGawitaM vastusvarUpaM praTamamavagamyate paScAt pratiyogiviSezApekzaTA hrasvaM dIrGamiti tadeva viSizya vyavahAraBAjanaM Bavati । taduktaM vizRutattvanirRaye “na ca viSezaRaviSezyatayA BedasidDiH viSezaRaviSezyaBAvaSca BedApekzaH, DarmipratiyogyapekzayA BedasidDiH BedApekzaYca DarmipratiyogitvamityanyonyASraTatayA BedasyAsidDeH padArTasvarUpatvAdBedasyetyAdinA” । ata eva gavArTino gavayadarSanAnna pravarttante goSabdaYca na smaranti । na ca nIrakzIrAdO svarUpe gfhyamARe BedapratiBAso'pi syAditiM BaRanIyaM samAnABihArAdipratibanDakabalAdBedaBAnaByavahArABAvopapatteH taduktam “atidUrAt sAmIpyAdindriyaGAtAnmano'navasTAnAt । sOkzmyAdvyavaDAnAdaBiBavAt samAnABihArAcceti” atidUrAd giriSiKaravarttitarvAdO, atisAmIpyAllocanAYjanAdO, indriyaGAtAdvidyudAdO, mano'navasTAnAt kAmAdyapaplutamanaskasya sPItAlokavarttini GazwAdO, sOkzmyAt paramARvAdO, vyavaDAnAt kuqyAdyantarhite, aBiBavAt divApradIpapraBAdO, samAnABihArAt nIrakzIrAdO yaTAvadgrahaRaM nAstItyarTaH । Bavatu vA DarmaBedavAdastaTApi na kaSciddozaH DarmipratiyogigrahaRe sati DarmaBedaBAnasamBavAt । na ca DarmaBedavAde tasya tasya Bedasya BedAntaraBedyatvenAnavasTA duravasTA syAdityAsTeyaM BedAntaraprasaktO mUlABAvAt BedaBedinO BinnAviti vyavahAradarSanAt । na cEkaBedabalenAnyaBedAnumAnaM dfzwAntaBedAviGAtenotTAnadozABAvAt । so'yaM piRyAkayAcanAya gatasya svArikAtEladAtftvAByupagama iva dfzwAntaBedavimarde tvanutTAnameva । na hi varaviGAtAya kanyodvAhaH । tasmAnmUlakzayABAvAdanavasTA na dozAya । a॰ numAnenApi Bedo'vasIyate । parameSvaro jIvAdBinnaH taM prati savyatvAt yo yaM prati sevyaH sa tasmAdBinnaH yaTA BftyAdrAjA । na hi suKaM me syAt duHKaM me na manAgapi iti puruzArTamarTayamAnAH puruzAH svapatipadaM kAmayamAnAH satkAraBAjo BaveyuH । pratyuta savAnarTaBAjanaM Bavanti । yaH svasyAtmano hInatvaM parasya guRotkarzaYca kaTayati sa stutyaH prItaH stAvakasya tasyABIzwaM prayacCati । tadAha “GAtayanti hi rAjAno rAjAhamiti vAdinam । dadatyaKilamizwaYca svagaRotkarzavAdinAmiti” । evaYca parameSvarABedavfzRayA vizRorguRotkarzasya mfgavazRikAsamatvABiDAnaM vipulakadalaPalalipsayA jihvAcCedamanuharati etAdfSavizRuvidvezaRAdanDatamasapraveSaprasaNgAt । tadetat pratipAditaM maDyamandireRa mahABAratatAtparyyanirRaye “anAdidveziBirdEtyErvizRordvezo vivardDitaH । tamasyanDe pAtayati dEtyAnanDe viniScayAditi” । sA ca sevA aNkananAmakaraRaBajanaBedAttriviDA । tatrANkana nArAyaRAyuDAdInAM, tadrUpasmaraRArTamapekzitArTasidDyarTaYca । taTA ca SAkalyasaMhitApariSizwam “cakraM viBartti puruzo'BitaptaM balaM davAnAmamftasya vizRoH । sa yAti nAkaM duritaM viDUya viSanti yadyatayo vItarAgAH । devAso yena viDftena bAhunA sudarSanena prayAtAstamAyan । yenANkitA manavo lokasfzwiM vitanvanti brAhmaRAstadvahanti । tadvizRoH paramaM padaM yena gacCanti lAYCitAH । urukramasya cihnEraNkitA loke suBagA BavAma” iti “ataptatanurna tadAno aSnute SritAsa idvahantastat samAsateti” tEttirIyakopanizacca । sTAnaviSezaScAgneyapurARe darSitaH “dakziRe tu kare vipro biBfyAdvE sudarSanam । mavyena SaNKaM viBfyAditi brahmavido viduriti” । anyatra cakraDAraRe mantraviSepaSca darSitaH “sudarSana! mahAjvAla! kowisUryyasamapraBa! । ajYAnAnDasya me nityaM vizRormArga pradarSaya । tvaM purA sAgarotpanno vizRunA viDftaH kare । namitaH sarvadevESca paYcajanya! namo'stu te iti” nAmakaraRaM putrAdInAM keSavAdinAmnA vyavahAraH sarvadA tannAmAnusmaraRArTam । BajanaM daSaviDaM vAcA satyaM hitaM priyaM svADyAyaH, kAyena dAnaM paritrARaM parirakzaRaM, manasA dayA spfhA SradDA ceti । atrEkEkaM nizpAdya nArAyaRe samarpaRaM majanam । taduktam “aNkanaM nAmakaraRaM BajanaM daSaDA ca taditi” । evaM jYeyatvAdinApi Bedo'numAtavyaH taTA SrutyApi Bedo'vagantavyaH satyametamanuviSve madanti rAtiM devasya gfRatomaGomaH satyAso asya mahimA gfRe SavoyajYeza viprarAjye satya AtmA satyo jIvaH satyaM BidA satyaM BidA mayi vAruRyo mayi vAruRyaH” iti mokzAnandaBedapratipAdakaSrutiByaH । “idaM jYAnamupASritya mama sAmarTyamAgatAH । sargepi nIpajAyante pralaye na vyaTanti ca” “jagadvyApAravarjam” “praBukaraRAsannitatvAccetyAdiByaSca । na ca “brahma veda brahmEva BavatIti” SrutibalAjjIvasya pAramESvaryyaM SakyaSaNkaM “sampUjya brAhmaRaM BaktyA SUdro'pi brAhmaRo Baveditivat vfMhito BavatItyarTaparatvAt । “nanu prapaYco yadi vartteta nivartteta na saMSayaH । mAyAmAtramirda dvEtamadvEtaM paramArTataH” iti vacanAt dvEtasya kalpitatvamavagamyata iti cet satyaM BAvamanaBisanDAyABiDAnAt taTA hi yadyayamutpadyeta tarhi nivartteta na saMSayaH । tasmAdanAdirevAyaM prakfzwaH paYcaviDo BedaprapaYcaH । na cAyamavidyamAnaH mAyAmAtratvAnmAyeti BagavadicCocyate । “mahAmAyetyavidyeti niyatirmohinIti ca । prakftirvAsanetyeva tavecCAnanta! kaTyate । prakfzwakftyA prakftirvAsanA vAsayedyataH । a ityakte haristasya mAyA'vidyeti saMjYitA । mAyetyuktA prakfzwatvAt prakfzwe hi mayABiDA । vizRoH prajYaptirevEkA SabdEretErudIryyate । prajYaptirUpo hi hariH sA ca svAnandalakzaRA” ityAdivacananicayaprAmARyabalAt । sEva prajYA mAnatrARakartrI ca yasya tanmAyAmAtraM tataSca parameSvareRa jYAtatvAdrakzitatvAcca na dvEtaM BrAntikalpitaM na hISvare sarvasya BrAntiH samBavati viSezAdarSananivanDanatvAdBrAnteH । tarhi tadvyapadeSaH kaTamityatrottaram advEtaM paramArTata iti paramArTata iti paramArTApekzayA tena sarvasmAduttamasya vizRutattvasya samAByaDikaSUnyatvamuktaM Bavati । taTA ca paramA SrutiH “jIveSvaraBidA cEva jaqeSvaraBidA taTA । jIvaBedo miTaScEva jaqajIvaBidA taTA । miTaSca jaqaBedo yaH prapaYco BedapaYcakaH । so'yaM satyo'pyanAdiSca sAdiScennASamApnuyAt । na ca nASaM prayAtyeza na cAsO BrAntikalpitaH । kalpitaScennivartteta na cAsO vinivarttate । dvEtaM na vidyata iti tasmAdajYAninAM matam । mataM hi jYAninAmata nmitaM trAtaM hi vizRunA । tasmAnmAtramiti proktaM paramo harireva tu” ityAdi । taKAdvizRoH sarvotkarza eva tAtparyyaM sarvAgamAnAm । etadevABisanDAyABihitaM BagavatA । “dvAvimO puruzO loke kzaraScAkzara eva ca । kzaraH sarvARi BUtAni kUwasTA'kzara ucyate । uttamaH puruzastvanyaH paramAtmetyudAhftaH । yo lokatrayamAviSya viBarttavyaya ISvaraH । yasmAt kzaramatIto'hamakzarAdapi cottamaH । ato'smi loke vede ca praTitaH puruzottamaH । yo mAmevamasaMmUQo jAnAti puruzottamam । sarvavidBajati mAM sarvaBAvena BArata! । iti guhyatamaM SAstramidamuktaM mayAnaGa! । etadbudDvA budDimAn syAt kftakftyaSca BArata!” । mahAvArAhe'pi “muKyaYca sarvavedAnAM tAtparyyaM SrIpatO pare । utkarze tu tadanyatra tAtparyyaM syAdavAntaram” iti । yuktaYca vizRoH sarvotkarze mahAtAtparyyam । “mokzo hi sarvapuruzArTottamaH DarmArTakAmAstvanityAH mokza eva nityaH tasmAnnityaM tadarTAya yateta matimAnnara” iti BAllaveyaSruteH । mokzaSca vizRuprasAdamantareRa na laByate । “yasya prasAdAt paramA yatsvarUprAt tasmAt sasArAmmucyate nAvare surAnArADayanto'sO paramo vicintyo mumukzuBiH karmapASAdamuzmAditi” nArAyaRaSrutiH । “taKin prasanne kimihAstyalaByaM sarvArTakAmEralamalpakAste । samASritAdbrahmataroranantAt niHsaMSayaM muktiPalaM prayAtaH” iti vizRupurARokteSca । “prasAdaSca guRotkarzajYAnAdeva nABedajYAnAdityuktam । na ca tattvamasyAditAdAtmyavyAkopaH SrutitAtparyyAparijYAnavijfmBaRAt । “Aha nityaparakzokzantu tacCabdI hyaviSezataH । tvaMSabdaScAparokzArTaM tayorEkya kaTaM Bavet । AdityoyUpa itivat sAdfSyArTA tu sA Srutiriti” । taTAca paramA SrutiH । jIvasya paramEkyaYca budDisArUpyameva vA । ekasTAnanivAse vA vyaktisTAnamapekzya vA । na svarUpEkatA tasya muktasyApi virUpataH । svAtantvapUrRate'lpatvapAratantrye virUpatA” iti । aTa vA tattvamasotyatra sa evAtmA svAtantryAdiguRopetvatAt atattvamasi tvaM tanna Bavasi tadrahitatvAdityekatvamatiSayena nirAkftam । tadAha “atattvamiti vA cCedastenEkyaM sunirAkftam” iti । tasmAt dfzwAntanavake'pi “sa yaTA SakuniH sUtreRa badDa” ityAdinA Beda eva dfzwAntABiDA nAya ayamaBedopadeSa iti tatvavAdarahasyam । taTAca mahopanizat “yaTA pakzo ca sUtraYca nAnAvfkzarasA yaTA । yaTA nadyaH samudrASca SudDodalavaRe yaTA । cArApahAryO ca yaTA yaTA puMvizayAvapi । taTA jIveSvarA BinnO sarvadEva vilakzaRO । taTApi sUkzmarUpatvAnna jIvAt paraso hariH । Bedena mandadfzwInAM dfSyate prerako'pi san । vElakzaRyaM tayorjYAtvA mucyate baDyate'nyayeti । brahmA SivaH surAdyASca SarIrakzaraRAt kzarAH । lakzmIrakzaradehatvAdakzarAtaH paro hariH । svAtantryaSaktivijYAnasuKAdyEraKilErguREH । nisImatvena te sarve tadvaSAH sarvadevatA” iti । vizRuM sarvaguREH pUrRaM jYAtvA saMsAravarjitaH । nirduHKAnandaBugnityaM tatsamIpe sa modate । muktAnAYcASrayo vizRuraDikADipatistaTA । tadvaSA eva te sarve sarvadEva sa ISvara” iti ca । ekavijYAnena sarvavijYAnaYca praDAnatvakAraRatvAdinA yujyate na tu sarvamiTyAtvena । na hi satyajYAnena miTyAjYAnaM samBavati yaTA praDAnapuruzARAM jYAnAjYAnAByAM grAmo jYAtaH ajYAta ityevamAdivyapadeSo dfzwa eva । yaTA ca kAraRe pitari jYAte jAnAtyasya putramiti । anyaTA “yaTA sOmyEkena mftpiRqena vijYAtena sarvaM mfRmayaM vijYAtam” ityatra ekapiRqaSabdO vfTA prasajyeyAtAM mfdA vijYAtayetyetAvatEva vAkyasya pUrRatvAt । na ca vAcAramBaRaM vikAro nAmaDeyaM mfttiketyeva satyasityetat kAryasya miTyAtvamAcazwe ityezwavyaM vAcAramBaRaM vikAro yasya tat avikftaM nityaM nAmaDeyaM mfttiketyAdikamityetadvacanaM satyamiti taTyasya svIkArAt । aparaTA nAmaDeyameveti SabdayorvEyarTyaM prasajyeta । ato na kutrApi jagato miTyAtvasidDiH । kiYca prapaYco miTyetyatra miTyAtvaM taTyamataTyaM vA । praTame satyAdvEtaBaNgaprasaNgaH carame prapaYcasatyatvApAtaH । nanvanityatvaM nityamanityaM vA uBayaTApyanupapattirityAkzepavadayamapi nityasamajAtiBedaH syAt । taduktaM nyAyanirvARaveDasA “nityamanityaBAvAdanityanityatvopapatternityasamaH” iti । tArkikarakzAyAYca “Darmasya tadatadUpavikalpAnupapattitaH । DarmiRastadviSizwatvaBaNgo nityasamo Bavet” iti । asyAH saMjYAyAH upalakzaRatvamaBipretyABihitaM praboDatidDO “anvarTitvAttUparaYjakaDarmasameti” । tasmAdasaduttarametaditi cet aSikzitatrAsanametat duzwatvamUlAnirUpaRAt । taddviviDaM sADAraRamasADAraRaYca tatrAdya svavyAGAtakaM dvitIyaM triviDaM yuktANgahInatvamayuktANgADikatvamavizayavfttitvaYceti । tatra sADAraRamasammAvitameva uktasyAkzepasya svAtmavyApanAnupalamBAt । evamasADAraRamapi Gawasya nAstitAyAM nAstitoktAvastitvavat prakfte'pyupapatteH । nanu prapaYcasya miTyAtvamaByupeyate nAsattvamiti veta gadetat so'yaM SiraSCede'pi SataM na dadAti viMSatiSaYcakantu prayacCatIti SAkawikadfttAntamanuharet miTyAtvAsattvayoH parTyAyatvAdityalamatiprapaYcena । tatra “aTAto brahma jijYAseti” praTamasUtrasyAyamarTaH tatrATaSabdo maNgalArRo'DikArAnantaryyArTaSca svIkriyate । ataHSabdI hetvarTaH taduktaM gAruqe “aTAtaHSabdapUrvARi sUtrARi niKilAnyapi । prAraBeta niyatyEva tatkimatraM niyAmakam । kaScArTastu tayorvidvAn kaTamuttamatA tayoH । etadAKyAhi me vrahman । yaTA jYAsyAmi tattvataH । evamukto nAradena vrahmA provAca sattamaH । AnantaryyADikAre ca laNgalArTe taTeva ca । aTaSabdastataHSabdo hetvarTe samudIritaH” iti । yato nArAyaRaprasAdamantareRa na mokzo laByate prasAdaSca jYAnamantareRa ato brahma jijYAsA karttavyeti sidDam । jijYAsyabrahmaRo lakzaRamuktaM “janmAdyasya yataH” iti । sfzwisTityAdi yato Bavati tadvrahmeti vAkyArTaH । taTAca skAndaM vacaH “utpattisTitisaMhArA niyatirjYAnamAvftiH । banDamokzO ca puruzAd yasmAt sa harirekarAq” iti । “yato vA imAnItyAdi” SrutiByaSca । tatra pramARamapyuktaM yaTA “SAstrayonitvAditi” । “nAvedavinmanute taM vfhantam” “tantvopanizadam” ityAdiSrutiByaH tasyAnumAnikatvaM nirAkriyate na cAnumAnasva svAtantryeRa prAmARyamasti । taduktaM kOrme “SrutisAhAyyarahitamanumAnaM na kutracit । niScayAt sADayedarTaM pramARAntarameva ca । SrugismftisahAyaM yat pramARAntaramuttamam । pramARapadavIM gacCennAtra kAryyA vicAraRA” iti SAsrasvarUpamuktaM skAnde “fgyajuH sAmATarvA ca BArataM pAYcarAtrakam । mUlarAmA yaRaYcEva SAstramityamiDIyate । yaccAnukUlametasya tacca SAstraM prakIrttitam । ato'nyo granTavistAro nEva SAstraM kuvartmataH” iti । tadanenAnanyalaByaH SAstrArTa iti nyAyena Bedasya prAptatvena tatra na tAtparyaM kintvadvEta eva vedavAkyAnAM tAtparyamiti advEtapratyASA pratikziptA anumAnAdISvarasya sidDyaBAvena tadBedasyApi tataH sidDya BAvAt । tasmAnna BedAnuvAdakatvamiti tatparatvamavagaByate ata evoktam “sadAgamEkavijYeyaM samatItakzarAkzaram । nArAyaRa sadA vande nirdozASezasadguRam” iti । SAstrasya tatra prAmARyamupapAditaM “tatu samanvayAditi” upantaya upakranAditiNgam uktaM GfhatsaMhitAyAma “upakramopasaMhArAvaByAso'pUrvatA Palam । arTavAdopapattIca liNgaM tAtparyanirRaye” iti । evaM vedAntatAtparyavaSAttadeva brahma SAstragamyamityuktaM Bavati । diqmArtramatra prAdarSi SizwamAnandatIrTaBAzyavyAKyAnAdO drazwavyaM granTavahutvaBiyoparamyata iti । etacca rahasyaM pUrRaprajYena maDyamandireRa vAyostftIyAvatAra manyena nirUpitamiti । “praTamastu hanUmAn syAt dvitIyo BIma eva ca । pUrRaprajYastftIyaSca BagavatkAryasADakaH” iti । etadevABipretya tatra tatra granTasamAptAvidaM padyaM liKyate “yasya trIRyuditAni vedavacane divyAni rUpARyalaM hyetaddarSitamitTametadaKilaM vedasya garBe mahaH । vAyo rAmavaconataM praTamakaM vfkzo dvitIyaM vapurmaDyo yastu tftIyametadamunA granGaH kftaH keSave” । tasmAt sarvasya SAstrasya vizRutattvaM sarvottamamityatra tAtparyamiti sarvaM niravadyam”

v: pu॰ bAhuyudDaBede tatprakAraH BA॰ sa॰ 22 a॰ ukto yaTA “tatastO naraSArdUlO bAhuSastrO samIyatuH । vIrO paramasahfzwAvanyo'nyajayakANkziRO । karagrahaRapUrvaM tu kftvA pAdABivandanam । kakzEH kakzAM viDunvAnAvAsPowaM tatra cakratuH । skanGe dorByAM samAhatya nihatya ca muhurmuhuH । aNgamaNgEH samASlizya punarAsPAlanaM viBo! । citrahastAdikaM kftvA kakzAbanDaM ca cakratuH । galagaRqABiGAtena sasPuliNgena cASanim । bAhupASAdikaM kftvA pAdAhatasirAvuBO । urohastaM tataScakrO pUrRakumBO prayujya tu । karasaMpIqanaM kftvA garjantO vAraRAviva । nardantO meGasaNkASO bAhupraharaRAvuBO । talenAhanyamAnO tu anyo'nyaM kftavIkzaRO । siMhAviva susaMkrudDAvAkfzyAkfzyAyuDyatam । aNgenANgaM samApIqya bAhuByAmuBayorapi । Avftya bAhuBiScApi udaraM ca pracakratuH । uBO kawyAM supArSve tu takzavantO ca SikzitO । aDohastaM svakaRWe tUrasyurasi cAkzipat । sarvAtikrAntamaryyAdaM pfzWaBaNgaM ca cakratuH । sa pUrRamUrdDaM bAhuByAM pUrRakumBaM pracakratuH । tfRapIqaM yaTAkAmaM pUrRayogaM samuzwikam । evamAdIni yudDAni prakurvantO parasparam” mU॰ “kakzErdormUlEH kakzAM prakozWagatAM rajjuM DunvAnO yatra yatra kakze AsPowaM cakratuH bAhumUlAsPAlanenANgadabanDarajjuSezaM kampayantAvityarTaH । citrahastAdikaM hastasyAtivegenAkuYcanaprasAraRoparyyaDaScAlana muzwIkaraRAni citrahastAH । AdipadAt pAdasyApyAkuYcanAdi । kakzAbanDaM parasparakakzAyAM hastO kftvA banDanam gale gaRqena BAladeSenABiDAtastena pAzARasadfSANgatvAttayoraBiDAtena visPuliNgotpattyA'SaniM vajramiva sasfjaturityarTaH । bAhupASAdikaM caraRapASa AdiSabdArTaH । pAdAByAmAhatAH sirAH snAyavo yAByAntO dfQaprahAreRa nAqIparyyantamapi vedanAvantAvityarTaH । urohastamurasi capewAprahAraM pUrRakumBO graTitANgaliByAM hastAByAM paraSirasaH pIqanaM pUrRakumBaH dvitvaM parasparaM dvAvapi cakraturiti vaktum । talena capewayA, Avftya jatrudeSe pfzWaM kftvA bAhuBirbahuByAM dvAvapi miTa udaramAdAya pracakratuH pracikzipatuH kF vikzepe'sya rUpam । evaM kawyAM supArSve ca pracakratuH । takzavantO takzastanUkaraRaM gAtrasaNkoca ityarTaH tadvantO । aDohastamudarasyADastAdDastaM kftvA hastAByAmudaramAvezwya svakaRWe Korasi ca kaRWoraHsamIpe AnIyAkzipadAsPAlitavAn । pfzWasya BUmambanDena jAtaM BaNgaM parABavaM bAhuByAmudarAdIni pIqane sampUrRamUrdDvam” nIlakaRwaH ।

s: strI, (pUrRiH pUraRam । pUrRiM mimIte iti । mA + kaH । wAp .) paYcadaSI tiTiH । tatparyyAyaH । pOrRamAsI 2 । niSAkare kalAhIne sA anumatiH 3 pUrRe niSAkare sA rAkA 4 । ityamaraH । 1 । 4 । 7-8 ॥ pitryA 5 cAndrI 6 pUrRamAsI 7 anantA 8 candramAtA 9 niraYjanA 10 । iti vAcaspatiH ॥ pUrRimA 11 । iti haqqacandraH ॥ jyotsnI 12 indumatI 13 sitA 14 । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ sA dviviDA । yaTA, -- “rAkA cAnumatI cEva dviviDA pUrRimA matA । pUrvvoditakalAhIne pOrRamAsyA niSAkare । pUrRimAnumatI jYeyA paScAstamitaBAskare ॥ yasmAttAmanumanyante devatAH pitfBiH saha । tasmAdanumatI nAma pUrRimA praTamA smftA ॥ yadA cAstamite sUryye pUrRacandrasya codgamaH । yugapat sottarA rAgAttadAnumatipUrRimA ॥ rAkAntAmanumanyante devatAH pitfBiH saha । raYjanAccEva candrasya rAketi kavayo'bruvan ॥” iti devIpurARam ॥ * ॥ sA candrasya tiTiH । yaTA, -- “tasya brahmA dadO prItaH pOrRamAsIM tiTiM praBuH । tasyAmupozayedrAjaMstamarTaM pratipAdayet ॥ na cAnnAhAraSca Bavettasya jYAnaM prayacCati । kAntiM puzwiYca rAjendra ! DanaM DAnyaYca kevalam ॥” iti varAhapurARe somotpattirahasyam ॥ * ॥ tasyAM jAtaPalam । “kandarpatulyo yuvatIpriyaSca nyAyAptavittaH satataM saharzaH । SUro balI SAstravicAradakzaScet pUrRimA janmani yasya jantoH ॥” iti kozWIpradIpaH ॥ * ॥ sA caturddaSIyuktA grAhyA yugmAt । yamaH । “pakzAnte srotasi snAyAttena nAyAti matpuram ॥” vizRuH । “dfSyete sahitO yasyAM divi candrabfhaspatI । pOrRamAsI tu mahatI jYeyA saMvatsare tu sA ॥ tasyAM snAnopavAsAByAmakzayaM parikIrttitam ॥” sahitO mAsasaMjYAviSezanimittakfttikAdinakzatragatO । mahAkArttikyAdidarSanAt । taTA ca rAjamArttaRqe । “mAsasaMjYe yadA fkze candraH saMpUrRamaRqalaH । guruRA yAti saMyogaM sA tiTirmahatI smftA ॥” skAndamAtsyayoH । “pOrRamAsIzu cEtAsu mAsarkzasahitAsu ca । etAsAM snAnadAnAByAM PalaM daSaguRaM smftam ॥” vESAKImaDikftya yamaH । “gOrAn vA yadi vA kfzRAMstilAn kzOdreRa saMyutAn । prIyatAM DarmmarAjeti pitFndevAMSca tarpayet ॥ yAvarjjAvakftaM pApaM tatkzaRAdeva naSyati । abdAyutaYca tizWecca svargaloke na saMSayaH ॥” * ॥ brahmapurARe । “mahAjyEzWyAntu yaH paSyet puruzaH puruzottamam । vizRulokamavApnoti mokzaM gaNgAmbumajjanAt ॥ * ॥ Endre guruH SaSI cEva prAjApatye ravistaTA । pUrRimA guruvAreRa mahAjyEzWI prakIrttitA ॥” anurADAsTagurAvapi । “Endre mEtre yadA jIvastatpaYcadaSake raviH । pUrRimA SakracandreRa mahAjyEzWI prakIrttitA ॥” anurADAsTacandre'pi । vyAGraBUtiH । “Endrarkze tvaTavA mEtre gurucandrO yadA sTitO । pUrRimA jyEzWamAsasya mahAjyEzWI prakIrttitA ॥” rAjamArttaRqe । “jyEzWe saMvatsare cEva jyazWamAsasya pUrRimA । jyezWAmena samAyuktA mahAjyEzWI prakIrttitA ॥” jyEzWasaMvatsaraSca । “jyezWAmUlopage jIve varzaM syAcCakradEvatam ॥” iti vizRuDarmmottarokto grAhyaH । saMvatsaro'tra vatsaro boDyaH । na tu saMvatsarAdipaYcakAntargatavarzaviSezaH । jyEzWa iti viSezaRasya vEyarTyApatteH । saMvatsare yadi syAttviti pAWaH kAlpanikaH । prapaYcastu malamAsatattve'nusanDeyaH ॥ * ॥ vizRuDarmmottarabrahmapurARayoH । “mAsi jyEzWe tu saMprApte nakzatre SakradEvate । pOrRamAsyAM tadA snAnaM sarvvapApaM hareddvijAH ॥ tasmin kAle tu ye martyAH paSyanti puruzottamam । balaBadraM suBadrAYca te yAnti padamavyayam ॥” skandapurARe । “jyEzWyAmahaYcAvatIrRastatpuRyaM janmavAsaram । tasyAM me snapanaM kuryyAnmahAsnAnaviDAnataH ॥ jyEzWyAM prAtaHsnAnakAle brahmaRA sahitaYca mAm । rAmaM suBadrAM saMsnApya mama lokamavApnuyAt ॥” vizRuDarmmottare । “pOrRamAsI taTA mAGI SrAvaRI ca narottamaH । prOzWapadyAmatItAyAM taTA kfzRA trayodaSI ॥ etAMstu SrAdDakAlAn vE nityAnAha prajApatiH ॥” tatra pUrvvadine saNgavalABe rOhiRalABe vA paradine saNgavAlABe pUrvvadine SrAdDam । “kfzRapakzasya pUrvvAhRe SrAdDaM kuryyAdvicakzaRaH । kfzRapakzAparAhRe tu rOhiRantu na laNGayet ॥” iti vAyupurARavacanAt ॥ uBayadine saNgavalABe paradine । “Suklapakze tiTirgrAhyA yasyAmaByudito raviH । kfzRapakze tiTirgrAhyA yasyAmastamito raviH ॥” iti vizRuDarmmottarAt ॥ evamakzayatftIyAdAvapi ॥ * ॥ AzAQakArttikamAGapOrRamAsIzu dAnamAvaSyakam । taTA cAyoDyAkARqe BarataSapaTe । “AzAQI kArttikI mAGI tiTayaH puRyasamBavAH । apradAnavato yAntu yasyAryyo'numato gataH ॥” apradAnavato dAnarahitasyEtAstiTayo yAntu AryyaH SrIrAmacandro gato yasyAnumataH ityanvayaH । uttaravAkye yacCabdAnna tacCabdApekzA ॥ aTa kojAgarakftyam । kalpatarO brahmapurARam । “ASvayujyAM pOrRamAsyAM nikumBo vAlukArRavAt । AyAti senayA sArdDaM kftvA yudDaM sudAruRam ॥ tasmAttatra narErmArgAH svagehasya samIpataH । SoDitavyAH prayatnena BUzitavyASca BUzaREH ॥ puzpArGyaPalamUlAnnasarzapaprakarEstaTA । veSmAni BUzitavyAni nAnAvarRErviSezataH ॥ susnAtEranuliptESca narErBAvyaM sabAnDavEH । divA tatra na BoktavyaM CAgavadBirhutASanaH ॥ uraBravadBirvaruRo gajavadBirvinAyakaH । pUjyaH sASvESca revanto yaTAviBavavistarEH ॥ tataH pUjyo nikumBo'pi samAzEstilataRqulEH । suganDiBirGftopetEH kfSarAdyESca BUriBiH ॥ brAhmaRAn BojayitvA tu BoktavyaM mAMsavarjitam । vahripArSvagatErneyA dfzwvA krIqAH pfTagviDAH ॥” tataSca dvArordDaBittihavyavAhanapUrRendusaBAryyarudraskandanandISvaramunayaH sarvvEreva pUjyAH । dvArordDvaBittiSabdo'tra bahuvacanAntaH । nandISvaramunirekaH । gomatA suraBiH । CAgavatA hutASanaH । mezavatA varuRaH । hastimatA vinAyakaH । aSvavatA revantaH । sarvvEreva nikumBaH pUjyaH । mahArRave liNgapurARam । “ASvine pOrRamAsyAntu carejjAgaraRaM niSi । kOmudI sA samAKyAtA kAryyA lokaviBUtaye ॥ kOmudyAM pUjayellakzmImindraYcErAvatasTitam । suganDirniSi sadveSo akzErjAgaraRaYcaret ॥” taTA, -- “niSITe varadA lakzmIH ko jAgarttItiBAziRI । tasmE vittaM prayacCAmi akzEH krIqAM karoti yaH । nArikelEScipiwakEH pitFn devAn samarccayet । banDUMSca prIRayettena svayaM tadaSano Bavet ॥” atra niSIti niSITa iti cABiDAnAdrAtrikftyamidam । “tataH pradozavyApinI grAhyA tiTirnaktavrate sadA । pradozo'stamayAdUrdDvaM GawikAdbayamizyate ॥” iti saMvatsarapradIpaDftavatsavacanAt ॥ yaddine pradozaniSIToBayavyApinI pOrRamAsI taddine kojAgarakftyam । uBayavyAptyanuroDAt । yadA tu pUrvvadine niSITavyAptiH paradine pradozavyAptistadA paredyustatkftyam । praDAnapUjAkAlavyAptyanuroDAt । yadA pUrvvedyurniSITavyAptiH paredyurna pradozavyAptistadA sutarAM pUrvvedyustatkftyam । “ahaHsu tiTayaH puRyAH karmmAnuzWAnato divA । naktAdivratayoge tu rAtriyogo viSizyate ॥” iti vacanAt ॥ varjayedityanuvfttO matsyasUkte । “mahAlakzmyAstu tulasIM JiRwikAM kAYcanantaTA ॥” lakzmIDyAnamAdityapurARe । “pASAkzamAlikAmBojasfRiBiryAmyasOmyayoH । padmAsanasTAM DyAyeYca SriyaM trElokyamAtaram ॥ gOravarRAM surUpAYca sarvvAlaNkAraBUzitAm । rOkmapadmavyagrakarAM varadAM dakziRena tu ॥” pASeti । dakziRe pASAkzamAlAByAM vAme padmANkuSAByAM BUzitAM vAmakare hemapadmaM dakziRakare varaM daDatItyarTaH । tataH pAdyAdiBiH saMpUjya, -- “o~ namaste sarvvadevAnAM varadAsi haripriye । yA gatistvatprapannAnAM sA me mUyAt tvadarccanAt ॥” ityanena puzpAYjalitrayaM dattvA praRamet ॥ indraDyAnamAdityapurARe । “caturddantagajArUQo vajrapARiH purandaraH । SacIpatiSca DyAtavyo nAnABaraRaBUzitaH ॥” pAdyAdiBiH saMpUjya, -- “o~ vicitrErAvatasTAya SaSvatkuliSapARaye । pOlomyAliNgitANgAya sahasrAkzAya te namaH ॥” iti puzpAYjalitrayaM dattvA praRamet । tataH kuveraH saMpUjyaH । iti rudraDaraH ॥ taM pAdyAdiBiH saMpUjya, -- “o~ DanadAya namastuByaM niDipadmADipAya ca । Bavantu tvatprasAdAnme DanaDAnyAdisampadaH ॥” iti praRamet ॥ atra pradoze sarvvezAM pUjeti rudraDarapraBftayaH ॥ na ca nikumBaparyyantAnAM pUrvvAhRa eva pUjanaM nirapavAdamiti vAcyam । divA tatra na BoktavyaM ityupakramya pUjyASca saPalEH patrErityAdinA viSizya pUjAmaBiDAya BoktavyamityaBiDAnAt rAtrAveva pUjABojane avagamyete । ataevASaktAnAmeva BoktavyaM pUjitEH surErityanena viSizya divA pUjABojane vihite ॥ * ॥ yoginItantre । “viriYcestu gfhe QakkAM GaRwAM lakzmIgfhe tyajet । sarvvavAdyamayIM GaRwAM vAdyABAve tu vAdayet ॥” * ॥ lakzmIvAkyam । “prakIrRaBARqAmanavekzya kAriRIM sadA ca BattuMH pratikUlavAdinIm । parasya veSmABiratAmalajjAmevaMviDAM strIM parivarjayAmi ॥” mArkaRqeyaH । “SiraH sapuzpaM caraRO supUjitO varANganAsevanamalpaBojanam । anagnaSAyitvamaparvvamETunaM cirapranazwAM SriyamAnayanti zaw ॥ mAnuzAsTi gfhe yatra ahorAtraYca tizWati । tatrAlakzmi ! tavAvAsastaTAnyezAYca rakzasAm ॥ sUrpadAtrAdikaM yatra padAkarzettaTAsanam ॥” harivaMSe । “yatra hrIH SrIH sTitA tatra yatra SrIstatra sammatiH । sammatirhrIstaTA SrISca nityaM kfzRe mahAtmani ॥” matsyapurARe । “sTiro hi yo hi puruzaH sTiraSrIreva jAyate । rakzituM nEva Saknoti capalaScapalAM Sriyam ॥” taTA, -- “avaSyamudyogavatAM SrIrapArA Bavet sadA । brahmaprotsAhitA devA mamanTuH punarambuDim ॥” kftyakOmudyAm । “nArikelodakaM pItvA akzErjAgaraRaM niSi । tasmE vittaM prayacCAmi ko jAgartti mahItale ॥” akzakrIqAyAM vyAsayuDizWirasaMvAdaH pracarati । tatkrIqA caturaNgaSabde drazwavyA ॥ * ॥ vEzRavAmfte skandapurARam । “pOzyAntu samatItAyAM yAvadBavati pUrRimA । mAGamAsasya devendra ! pUjA vizRorviDIyate ॥” iti । pOrRamAsyantamAsamupakramya । “pitaRAM devatAnAYca mUlakaM nEva dApayet । dadannarakamApnoti BuYjIta brAhmaRo yadi ॥ brAhmaRo mUlakaM BuktvA careccAndrAyaRavratam । anyaTA narakaM yAti kzattro viw SUdra eva ca ॥ varaM BakzyamaBakzyaYca pibedvA garhitaYca yat । varjjanIyaM prayatnena mUlakaM madirAsamam ॥” * ॥ PAlgune dolayAtrAmAha tIrTacintAmaRO brahmapurARam । “naro dolAgataM dfzwvA govindaM puruzottamam । PAlgunyAM saMyato BUtvA govindasya puraM vrajet ॥” skandapurARIyapuruzottamamAhAtmye UnatriMSADyAye । “PAlgunyAM krIqanaM kuryyAt dolAyAM mama BUmipa ! ॥” iti tiTitattvam ॥ * ॥ tasyAH parvvatvaM parvvaSabde drazwavyam ॥
v: strI pUrRiM pUrttiM mimIte ma--ka । 1 pOrRamAsya tiTO marIceH kalAyAM patnyAM jAte 2 kanyABede “BAryyA marIcestu kalA suzuve kardamAtmajA । kaSyapaM pUrRikAYcEva yayorApUritaM jagat । pUrRikA'sUta virajaM viSvagaYca parantapa! । BAga॰ 4 । 1 । 12 tattivisvarUpaM dvEDe KaRqaBedasya karmaBede grAhyatAdikaM ca kAlamA॰ nyarUpi yaTA “tatra SuklAyAM paYcadaSyAM candramaRqalaM svakalAmiH sarvAtmanA pUryyate seyaM maRqalaparipUrttiH pUrRimetyanena nAmnA jYAyate । taduktaM brahmARqamatsyapurARayoH “kAlakzaye vyatikrAnte divApUrRO parasparam । candrAdityO parAhRe tu pUrRatvAt pUrRimA smftA” iti । ahnaH paro BAgaH parAhRaH sUryyAstamayakAla ityarTaH । tatra yaTAdityaH saMpUrRamaRqalaH sannastameti taTottarakzaRe candraH sampUrRamaRqalaH sannudetIti । dfzwAntadArzwAntikaBAvasya vivakzitatvAd dvayorAdityacandrayorupanyAsaH । yaTA maRqalapUrRatvavivakzayA pUrRimASabdaH prayujyate taTA mAsapUrRatvavivakzayA pOrRamAsISabdaH prayujyate । nadurktaM Bavizyottare “pOrRamAsI mahArAja । somasya dayitA tiTiH । pUrRo mAso Baved yasmAt pOrRamAsI tataH smftA” iti । pUrRimAmAvAsyayorvikalpena mAsAntatvaM mAsaprastAve darSitam । ataeva pOrRamAsyAmatyantaviprakarze satyanaBiBUtatvAccandramaRqalaH sampUrRo dfSyate । tAvetO sannikarzaviprakarzO goBila Aha “yaH paro viprakarzaH sUryyAcandramasIH sA pOrRamAsI । yaH paraH sannikarzaH sAmAvAsyeti” । tadevaM parvABiDAyAH paYcadaSyAH pUrRimAdinAmanirvacanena svaBAvaviSezo jYAprito Bavati । te ca pUrRamAsyAmAvAsye pratyekaM dviviDe । tacca purARe darSitam “rAkA cAnumatiScEva pOrRamAsI dviDA smftA । sinIbAlI kuhUScEvamamAvAsyA dviDEva tu” iti । etAsAM catasfRAM svarUpaM kAWakaSAKAyAM vispazwaM SrUyate “yA pUrvA pOrRRamAsI sAnumatiryottarA sA rAkA । yA pUrvA'mAvAsyA sA sinIbAlI yottarA sA kuhUH” iti । vfhadvaSizWo'pi “rAkA AnumatiScEva pOrRamAsIdvayaM viduH । rAkA saMpUrRacandrA syAt kalonA'numatirmatA । pOrRamAsI divA dfzwe SaSinyanumatiH smftA । rAtridfzwe punastasmin sEva rAketi kIrttitA” । matsyabrahmARqapurARayoH “yasmAttAmanumanTante pitaro dEvatEH saha । tasmAdanumatirnAma pUrRimA praTamA smftA । atTarTaM rAjate yasmAt pOrRamAsyAM niSAkaraH । raYjanAccEva candrasya rAketi kavayo viduH” iti । “aTa paYcadaSI nirRIyate । sA dviviDA pOrRasAsyamAvAsyA ca । tatra pOrRamAsyAM parasparavirudDAni vAkyAnyupalaByante । tatra paravidDATA grAhyatvaM vizRuDarmottare “ekAdaSyazwamI zazWI pOrRamAsI caturdaSI । amAvAsyA tftIyA ca upozyA syuH parAtvitAH” । paravidDAnizEDaH pUrbavidDAviDiSca brahmapurARapadmapurARayoH “GazWyekAdaSyamAvAsyA pUrbavidDA taTA'zwamI । pUrRRimA paravidDA ca nopozyaM tiTipaYcakam । pUrvabidDA tu karttavyA saptamI bratiBirnarEH । pOrRamAsI, mahIpAlaparAyA niyamANgatA” iti । pUrbabidDAgrAhyatva ca yunmavAkye । “caturdaSyA ca pUrRRimati” । evaM parasparaviroDe sati yA vyavasTA sA brahmavEvartte darSitA “pUrvavidDA na karttavyA amAvAsyA ca pUrRimA । varjayitvA muniSnezWa! sAvitrIvratamuttamam” iti । sAvitrI rAjakanyA tayA cIrRaM vrataM sAvitrovratam । tacca mavizyottarapurARe darSitam “kaTayAmi kulastrIRAM mahimno vardDanaM param । yaTA cIrRRaM vrataM pUrbaM sAvitryA rAjakanyayA” iti । etacca pOrRRamAsyAmamAvAsyAyAM ca vihitam । tasmin vrate pUrbavidDA grAhyA । vratAntare pUrbabidDA na karttavyA kintu paravidDEva karttavyeti parasparavirudDasya SAstradvayasya vyavasTA । yadA tu caturdaSyazwAdaSanAqikA Bavati tadA sAvitrIvratamapi tatra parityAjyas । “BUto'zwAdaSanAqoBirdUzayatyuttarAM tiTimiti” smfteH । yo'yaM pOrRamAsInirRRava sa evAmAvAsyAyAsapyavagantavyaH । tatrApi sAvitrIvrataM pUrvadine karttavyaM vratAntarARyuttaradine । asyAM ca vyavasTAyAM brahmavEvarttavacanaM pUrbamudAhftam । skandapurARe'pi “BUtavidDA sinIvAlI na tu tatra vrataM caret । varjayitvA tu sAvitrIvrataM tu SiKinAhana!” iti । evaM ca sati yugmaSAstraM sAvitrIvratavyatiriktezu vratezu drazwavyam । pracetA api “nAgabidDA tu yA zazWI saptamyA ca yutAzwamI । daSasyekAdaSIvidDA trayodaSyA caturdaSI । BUtabidDApyamAvAsyA na grAhyA munipuNgavEH । uttarottaravidDAstAH karttavyAH kAWakI SrutiH” iti । padmapurARe'pi “zazWyazwamI taTA darSaH kfzRapakze trayodaSI । etAH parayutAH kAryyAH parAH pUrbeRa saMyutAH” iti । yattu nAradIyapurARe “darSaM ca pOrRa mAsaM ca zituH sAMvatsaraM dinam । pUrbabidDamakurvARo narakaM pratipradyate” iti tat sAvitrIvratavizayaM SrAvizayaM vA । amAvAsyAyAmiva pOrRamAsyAmapi SrAdDa vihitam taTAca pitAmahaH “amAvAsyAvyatIpAtapOrRamAsyazwakAsu ca । vidvAn SrAdDamakurvARaH prAyaScittIyate hi saH” iti । amAbAsyASrAdDasya ca pArvaRarUpatvamaparAhRasya tatkarmakAlatvaM kutapasya prAramBakAlatvamityetattritayaM pratipatprakaraRe pratyAvdikanirRaye prapaYcitam” । “sA caturdaSIyutA grAhyA yummAt । yamaH “pahmAnte srotasi snAyAt tena nAyAti matpuram” vizRuH “dfSyete sahitO yasyAM divi candravfhaspatI । pOrRRamAmI tu mahatI jYeyA saMvatsare tu sA । tasyAM snAnopavAsA ByAmakzayaM parikIrttitam” । sahito mAsamaMjYAnimittakfttikAdinakzatragatO mahAkArttikyAdidarSanAt । naTA ca rAjamArttaRqaH “mAsasaMjYe yadA fkze candraH sampUrRamaRqalaH । guruRA yAti saMyogaM sA tiTirmahatI smftA” । skAndamAtsyayoH “pOrRRamAsIzu cEtAzu mAsarkzasahitAsu ca । etAsu snAnadAnAByAM PalaM daSaguRaM smftam” ti॰ ta॰ sTitam ।

praSasyate ॥ grIvATa karRO pfzWaYca hrasve jaNGe supUjite । catvAri yasya hrasvAni pUjAM prApnoti nityaSaH ॥ sUkzmARyaNguliparvvARi dantakeSanaKatvacam । paYca sUkzmARi yezAM hi te narA dIrGajIvinaH ॥ nAsA netraYca dantASca lalAwaYca SirastaTA । hfdayaYcEva vijYeyamunnataM zaw praSasyate ॥ pARipAdatalO raktO netrAntaranaKAni ca । tAluko'DarajihvA ca saptaraktaM praSasyate ॥ svaro budDiSca nABiSca trigamBIramudAhftam । uraH Siro lalAwaYca trivistIrRaM praSasyate ॥ * ॥ kawirviSAlA bahuputtraBAgI viSAlahasto narapuNgavaH syAt । uro viSAlaM DanaDAnyaBAgI Siro viSAlaM narapUjitaH syAt ॥ na SrIstyajati raktAkzaM nArTaH kanakapiNgalam । dIrGabAhuM na cESvaryyaM na mAMsopacitAMsakam ॥ kadAciddanturo mUrKaH kadAcillomaSaH suKI । kadAcittundilo duHKI kadAciccaYcalA satI ॥ netrasnehena sOBAgyaM dantasnehena Bojanam । hastasnehena cESvaryyaM pAdasnehena vAhanam ॥ akarmmakaWinO hastO pAdAvaDvani komalO । yasya pARitalO raktO tasya rAjyaM vinirddiSet ॥ dIrGaliNgena dAridryaM sTUlaliNgena nirDanaH । kfSaliNgena sOBAgyaM hrasvaliNgena BUpatiH ॥ reKABirbbahuBirduHKaM svalpABirDanahInatA । raktABiH SriyamApnoti kfzRABirlokapUjitaH ॥ aNguzWodaramaDye tu yavo yasya virAjitaH । unnataM BojanaM tasya SataM jIvati mAnavaH ॥ aNkuSaM kuliSaM CatraM yasya pARitale Bavet । ESvaryyaYca vinirddizwamaSItyAyurBavedGruvam ॥ Danuryasya Bavet pARO paNkajaM vATa toraRam । tasyESvaryyaYca rAjyaYca aSItyAyurBavedDruvam ॥ kanizWAtarjjanIM yAvat reKA Bavati cAkzatA । viMSatyabdADikaSataM narA jIvantyanAmayAH ॥ kanizWAmaDyamAM yAvat reKA Bavati cAkzatA । SatAbdaM vATa vASItirnaro jIvenna saMSayaH ॥ kanizWAnAmikAyAYcet reKA Bavati cAkzatA । zazwiM paYcASadabdaM vA narA jIvantyasaMSayam ॥ reKayA Bidyate reKA svalpAyuSca BavennaraH । kanizWAyAM sTitA reKA saMKyA yAvatikA smftA । tAvatI puruzARAntu nArI Bavati niScitam ॥ karamaDyagatA reKA DruvA UrdDvamBavedyadi । nfpo vA nfpatulyo vA ciraM KyAto'rTavAn Bavet ॥ matsyapucCaprakIrRena vidyAvittasamanvitaH । pitAmahasya vA kiYcit DanaYca laBate Druvam ॥ maDyamAyAM yadi yavA dfSyante'tyantaSoBanAH । tadAnyasaYcitaM vittaM prApnotyaNguzWake yave ॥ yasyATa cakramaNguzWe yavAdUrdDvaYca dfSyate । tadA vE pAmarAdInAmajjitaM DanamApnuyAt ॥ tarjjanyAmaTa cakraYca mitradvArA DanamBavet । tenEva viparItantu vyayo Bavati niScitam ॥ maDyamAyAM sTite cakre devadvArA DanaM laBet । tenEva viparItantu vyayo Bavati niScitam ॥ anAmAyAM Bavet cakraM sarvvadbArA BavedDanam । tenEva viparItantu vyayo Bavati niScitam ॥ kanizWAyAM BaveccakraM bARijyena DanaM Bavet । tenEva viparItantu vyayo Bavati niScitam ॥ * ॥ lalAwe dfSyate yasya cakrareKAcatuzwayam । aSItyAyuH samApnoti paYcareKAH SataM samAH ॥ yasyonnataM lalAwaYca tAmrakarRaYca dfSyate । reKAhInaSca kakzaSca sa conmatto mahIM Bramet ॥ yasya jihvA BaveddIrGA nAsAgraM leQi sarvvadA । BogI Bavati nirvvARaH pfTvIM Bramati sarvvadA ॥ dantASca viralA yasya nIcavannIcakarmmakft । pragalBo danturaH satyaM vedAntapArago Bavet ॥” prakArAntaram । “dantASca viralA yasya gaRqe kUpo'pi jAyate । parastrIramaRo nityaM paravittena vittavAn ॥ dIrGaliNge ca sOBAgyaM sUkzmaliNge nfpo Bavet । vakrAsyakaWinErliNgEH pramARAnnirgataH sadA ॥ ramate ca sadA dAsyAM nirGano Bavati Druvam । kfSaliNgena sUkzmeRa raktavarRena BUpatiH । bahustrIramaRo nityaM nArIRAM vallaBo Bavet ॥ kfSaliNgena raktena laBate cottamANganAm । rAjyaM suKaYca divyANgyAH kanyakAyAH patirBavet ॥ yasya pAdatale padmaM cakraM vApyaTa toraRam । aNkuSaM kuliSaM vApi sa rAjA Bavati Druvam ॥ kfSanirlomaSA ye syuH kekarAkzAH kucelakAH । kAtarA vyAlajihvASca te daridrA na saMSayaH । kapilA malinANgASca hrasvAScEva bfhannaKAH ॥ kfSAtidIrGA manujAste daridrA na saMSayaH । civuke SmaSruSUnyA ye nirlomahfdayASca ye । te DUrttA nEva sandehaH samudravacanaM yaTA ॥ sUcImuKA BagnapfzWAH kfzRadantAH kucelakAH । vakranAsA vajranAsAste narA duzwamAnasAH ॥ dayAlavaSca dAtAro rUpavanto jitendriyAH । paropakAriRaScEva te'pUrvvA mAnavAH smftAH ॥” iti sAmudrake puruzalakzaRam ॥ * ॥ a: पूर्व — a. (Declined like a pronoun when it implies relative position in time or space, but optionally so in nom. pl.; and abl. and loc. sing.) 1 Being in front of, first, foremost. --2 Eastern, easterly, to the east of; ग्रामात्पर्वतः पूर्वः Sk. --3 Previous to, earlier than. --4 Old, ancient; पूर्वसूरिभिः R. 1. 4; इदं कविभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यो नमोवाकं प्रशास्महे U. 1. 1. --5 Former, previous, interior, prior, antecedent (opp. उत्तर); in this sense often at the end of comp. and translated by ‘formerly’ or ‘before’; श्रुतपूर्व &c. --6 Aforesaid, before-mentioned. --7 Initial. --8 Established, customary, of long standing. --9 Early, prime. पूर्वे वयसि Pt. 1. 165 ‘in early age or prime of life.’ --10 (At the end of comp.) Preceded by, accompanied by, attended with; संबंधमाभाषणपूर्वमाहुः R. 2. 58; पुण्यः शब्दो मुनिरिति मुहुः केवलं राजपूर्वः Ś. 2. 14; तान्स्मितपूर्वमाह Ku. 7. 47; बहुमानपूर्वया 5. 31; दशपूर्वरथं यमाख्यया दशकंठारिगुरुं विदुर्बुधाः R. 8. 29; so मतिपूर्वं Ms. 11. 147 ‘intentionally’, ‘knowingly’; 12. 89; अबोधपूर्वं ‘unconsciously’, Ś. 5. 2 &c. --र्वः An ancestor, a forefather; पूर्वैः किलायं परिवर्धितो नः R. 13. 3; पयः पूर्वैः सनिश्वासैः कवोष्यमुपभुज्यते 1. 67; 5. 14; अनुकारिणि पूर्वेषा युक्तरूपमिदं त्वायि Ś. 2. 16. --र्वं The forepart; अनवरतधनुर्ज्यास्फालनक्रूरपूर्वं (गात्रं) Ś. 2. 4. --र्वा 1 The east --2 N. of a country to the east of Madhyadeśa. --र्वं ind. 1 Before (with abl.); मासात्पूर्वं. --2 Formerly, previously, at first, antecedently, before-hand; तं पूर्वमभिवादयेत् Ms. 2. 117; 3. 94; 8. 205; R. 12. 35; प्रणिपातपूर्वं K.; भूतपूर्वखरालयं U. 2. 17 ‘which formerly was the abode’, &c.; समयपूर्वं Ś. 5 ‘after a formal agree ment.’ --3 Immemorially. (पूर्वेण ‘in front, before’, to the east of’, with gen. or acc.); अद्य पूर्वं ‘tillnow’, hitherto’; पूर्वंः -ततः -पश्चात उपरि ‘first-then, first-afterwards’, ‘previously, subsequently’, पूर्वंअधुता or अद्य ‘formerly-now.’ --Comp. --अग्निः the sacred fire kept in the house (आवसथा). --अचलः, --अद्रिः the eastern mountain behind which the sun and moon are supposed to rise. --अधिकारिन् m. the first occupant, a prior owner. --अंतः the end of a preceding word. --अपर a. {1} eastern and western. कतमोऽयं पूर्वापरसमुद्रावगाढःसानुमानालोक्यत Ś. 7; पूर्वापरौ तोयनिधी वगाह्य Ku. 1. 1. {2} first and last. {3} prior and subsequent, preceding and following. {4} connected with another. --(रं) {1} what is before and behind. {2} connection. {3} the proof and the thing to be proved. ˚विरोधः inconsistency, incongruity. --अभिमुख a. turned towards or facing the east. --अभ्यासः former practice or experience. --अंबुधिः the eastern ocean. --अर्जित a. attained by former works. --(तं) ancestral property. --अर्धः --र्धं {1} the first half; दिनस्य पूर्वार्धपरार्धभिन्ना छायेव नैत्री खलसज्जनानां Bh. 2. 60; समाप्तं पूर्व र्धं &c. {2} the upper part (of the body); शकुंतला पूर्वार्धेन शयनादुत्थाय Ś. 3; R. 16. 6. {3} the first half of a hemistich. --अह्ण; the earlier part of the day, forenoon, Ms. 4. 96; 152. (पूर्वाह्णतन, पूर्वाह्णिकः पूर्वाह्णतन a. relating to the forenoon). --आवेदकः a plaintiff. --आषाढा N. of the 20th lunar mansion consisting of two stars. --इतर a, western. --उक्त, --उदित a. beforementioned, aforesaid. --उत्तर a. northeastern. --(रा) the northeast. (--रे dual) the preceding and following, antecedent and subsequent. --कर्मन् n. {1} a former act or work. {2} the first thing to be done, a prior work. {3} actions done in a former life. {4} preparations, preliminary arrangements. --कल्पः former times. --कायः {1} the forepart of the body of animals; पश्चार्धेन प्रविष्टः शरपतनभयाद्भूयसा पूर्वकायं Ś. 1. 7. {2} the upper part of the body of men; स्पृशन् करेणानतपूर्वकायं R. 5. 32; पर्यंकबंधस्थिरपूर्वकायं Ku. 3. 45. --काल a. belonging to ancient times. --(लः) former or ancient times. --कालिक, --कालीन a. ancient. --काष्ठा the east, eastern quarter. --कृत a. previously done. --(तं) an act done in a former life. --कोटिः f. the starting point of a debate, the first statement or पूर्वपक्ष q. v. --गंगा N. of the river Narmadā. --चोदित a. {1} aforesaid, above-mentioned. {2} previously stated or advanced (as an objection). --ज a. {1} born or produced before or formerly, first-produced, firstborn. {2} ancient, old. {3} eastern. --(जः) {1} an elder brother; Śi. 6. 44; R. 15. 36. {2} the son of the elder wife. {3} an ancestor, a forefather: स पूर्वजानां कपिलेन रोषात् R. 16. 34. {4} (pl.) the progenitors of mankind. {5} the Manes living in the world of the moon. --(जा) an elder sister. --जन्मन् n. a former birth. (--m.) an elder brother; R. 14. 44; 15. 95. --जातिः f. a former birth. --ज्ञानं knowledge of a former life. --दक्षिण a. south-eastern. --(णा) the south-east. --दिक्पतिः Indra, the regent of the east. --दिन the forenoon. --दिश् f. the east. --दिश्य a. situated towards the east, eastern. --दिष्टं the award of destiny. --देवः {1} an ancient deity. {2} a demon or Asura. {3} a progenitor (पितृ). {4} (dual) an epithet of Nara-Nārāyaṇa. --देवता a progenitor (पितृ) of gods or of men: अक्रोधनाः शौचपराः सततं ब्रह्मचारिणः . न्यस्तशस्त्रा महाभागाः पितरः पूर्वदेवताः ... --देशः the eastern country, or the eastern part of India. --निपातः the irregular priority of a word in a compound; cf. परनिपात --पक्षः {1} the forepart or side. {2} the first half of a lunar month. {3} the first part of an argument, the prima facie argument or view of a question. {4} the first objection to an argument. {5} the statement of the plaintiff. {6} a suit at law. {7} an assertion, a proposition. ˚पादः the plaint, the first stage of a legal proceeding. --पदं the first member of a compound or sentence. --पर्वतः the eastern mountain behind which the sun is supposed to rise. --पांचालक a. belonging to the eastern Pañcālas. --पाणिनीयाः (m. pl.) the disciples of Pāṇini living in the east. --पालिन् m. an epithet of Indra. --पितामहः a forefather, an ancestor. --पुरुषः {1} an epithet of Brahmā. {2} any one of the first three ancestors, beginning with the father (पितृ, पितामह, and प्रपितामह); Pt. 1. 89. {3} an ancestor in general. --पूर्व a. each preceding one. --(र्वाः) m. pl. forefathers. --फल्गुनी the eleventh lunar mansion containing two stars ˚भवः an epithet of the planet Jupiter. --भागः {1} the forepart. {2} the upper part. --भा (भ) द्रपदा the twenty fifth lunar mansion containing two stars. --भावः {1} priority. {2} prior or antecedent existence; येन सहैव यस्य यं प्रति पूवभावोऽवगम्यते Tarka K. {3} (Rhet.) disclosing an inten tion. --भाषिन् a. willing to speak first; hence polite, courteous. --भुक्तिः f. prior occupation or possession. --भूत a. preceding, previous. --मीमांसा ‘the prior or first Mīmāmsā’, an inquiry into the first or ritual portion of the Veda, as opposed to the उत्तरमीमांसा or वेदांत; see मीमांसा. --रंगः the commencement or prelude of a drama, the prologue; यन्नाट्यवस्तुनः पूर्वं रंगविघ्नोपशांतये . कुशीलवाः प्रकुर्वंति पूर्वरंगः स उच्यते .. D. R.; पूर्वरगं विधायैव सूत्रधारो निवर्तते S. D. 283; पूर्वरंगः प्रसंगाय नाटकीयस्य वस्तुनः Śi. 2. 8 (see Malli. thereon). --रागः the dawning or incipient love, love between two persons which springs (from some previous cause) before their meeting; श्रवणाद्दर्शनाद्वापि मिथः संरूढरागयोः . दशाविशेषोऽयो प्राप्तौ पूर्वराग स उच्यते ... k.v: धाताब्जयोनिर्द्रुहिणो विरिञ्चिः कमलासनः। स्रष्टा प्रजापतिर्वेधा विधाता विश्वसृट्विधिः। नाभिजन्माण्डजः पूर्वो निधनः कमलोद्भवः। सदानन्दो रजोमूर्तिः सत्यको हंसवाहनः॥
दिशस्तु ककुभः काष्ठा आशाश्च हरितश्च ताः। प्राच्यवाचीप्रतीच्यस्ताः पूर्वदक्षिणपश्चिमाः॥
कुबेरः ईशः पतयः पूर्वादीनां दिशां क्रमात्. रविः शुक्रो महीसूनुः स्वर्भानुर्भानुजो विधुः। बुधो बृहस्पतिश्चेति दिशां चैव तथा ग्रहाः। ऐरावतः पुण्डरीको वामनः कुमुदोऽञ्जनः॥
अप्येकसर्ग एकाग्र्योऽप्येकायनगतोऽपि सः। पुंस्यादिः पूर्वपौरस्त्यप्रथमाद्या अथास्त्रियाम्.।

m: पूषन् m. (the अ not lengthened in the strong cases, but acc. ˚षाणम्, in MārkP.) N. of a Vedic deity (originally connected with the sun, and therefore the surveyor of all things, and the conductor on journeys and on the way to the next world, often associated with Soma or the Moon as protector of the universe; he is, moreover, regarded as the keeper of flocks and herds and bringer of prosperity; in the Brāhmaṇas he is represented as having lost his teeth and feeding on a kind of gruel, whence he is called करम्भाद्; in later times he is one of the 12 Ādityas and regent of the Nakṣatra Revatī or Pauṣṇa; du. ‘Pūṣan and Aryaman’, VP., Sch.)
the sun, Kād.; Bālar.
(?) growth, increase (cf. पूष-राति)
the earth, L.
a: पूषन् — m. (nom. पूषा, --षणौ, --षणः) [पूष्-कनिन्; Uṇ. 1. 156] The sun; सदापांथः पूषा गगनपरिमाणं कलयति Bh. 2. 114; इंधनौघधगप्यग्निस्त्विषा नात्येति पूषणं Śi. 2. 43. --Comp. --असुहृद् m. an epithet of Śiva. --आत्मजः {1} a cloud. {2} an epithet of Indra. --दंतहरः an epithet of Vīrabhadra; see अदंत. --भासा the city of Indra.
